answer: Fraud bonds price out clones. A key parks 2,350 POA yield-free in a glacier for 19 epochs. Any stranger may lock 400 POA on a public dispute bridge and fire a beacon: a 36-byte prompt due in 22s, plus the funding path. Three jurors replay both. A late or copied reply, or a second key from the same payer, moves 700 POA from the glacier to the challenger and benches it 17 epochs; a false charge burns the bond. One honest lock is 2,350 POA; 800 fakes freeze 1.88 million POA, vs ~150 POA. Weakness: harassment floods; cap one live beacon per key each epoch and refund a valid defense plus 80 POA.
